name: hypromellose 2910 (4000 mpa.s) + naphazoline
uses: Uses Temporarily relieves redness due to minor eye irritation protection against further irritation burning and irritation due to dryness of the eye
otcwarn: Do not use if solution changes color or becomes cloudy. ask a doctor before use if you have narrow angle glaucoma. Stop use and ask a doctor if you experience eye pain, changes in vision, continued redness or irritation of the eye condition worsens or persists for more than 72 hours. overuse may cause more redness of the eye pupil may become enlarged temporarily
